subject: Extend demo block for composite governance review
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo on Mar 3 — request to extend for governance + security

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for scheduling the product walkthrough on Mar 3 at 11:00am PT. A quick update from our side: AtlasHealth mentioned they want to bring their Security and Procurement leads into the session. That will change the scope — we typically run a 45–60 minute commercial demo, but for a combined governance + technical walkthrough with procurement questions we'd like to extend to ~90 minutes so we can:

- cover compliance evidence (SOC2, audit logs, retention)
- run a short infra/ops Q&A and failover discussion
- collect procurement next steps and contract Q&A

I've attached a brief compliance checklist to make sure we hit the right artifacts (Attachment: compliance-checklist.pdf). Can you confirm whether the new stakeholders are available for a 90-minute block? If not, please share a couple of alternate windows next week.

If helpful we can also split into a 60-minute product + 30-minute security/procurement deep-dive — whatever works best for your team.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

(Attachment: compliance-checklist.pdf, 120KB)

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo on Mar 3 — request to extend for governance + security

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the heads up. We added Priya (security lead) and Michael (procurement) to the invite — both requested more time. Also note: several folks on our side will be traveling Mar 3 and asked whether we can move to the following week.

Two windows that look promising for us:
- Tue Mar 7, 10:00–11:30am PT
- Wed Mar 8, 1:00–2:30pm PT

Either would work if you can provide the longer block. We also need a quick pass on audit-log retention and encryption keys during the call.

Sam
Sam Patel | Head of Data Platforms, AtlasHealth
sam.patel@atlashealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0122

Subject: Re: Demo on Mar 3 — request to extend for governance + security

Hi Sam + team —

Irene flagged that more stakeholders are joining — happy to adapt. We generally recommend a 90-minute session for a combined product + security + procurement agenda. Proposed plan: 60 minutes product demo (incl. KV caching, routing policy examples) + 20 minutes security/ops + 10 minutes procurement next steps and contract timeline.

Two concrete options from our calendar (both PT):
- Tue Mar 7, 10:00–11:30am (preferred)
- Wed Mar 8, 13:00–14:30

If you confirm either, I'll update the invite and add a short agenda and relevant SMEs. Attached is a quick spreadsheet listing the internal SMEs and suggested ownership for agenda items (Attachment: proposed-ma-roles.xlsx).

Also, Sam — you mentioned audit-log retention and keys. Karthik, can you prepare 5–7 slides on audit logs and key management? We can drop them into the shared agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

(Attachment: proposed-ma-roles.xlsx)

Marissa / Irene —

Agenda looks good — please include the staging failover demo if it's not onerous (we think seeing a short failover demo is useful). Also send the dial-in + calendar invite when you have it.

Thanks — locking the slot.
Sam
